preconditions.description: The number of rows in the grid is between 1 and 2500, inclusive.
The number of columns in the grid is between 1 and 2500, inclusive.
The number of actions is between 1 and 100000, inclusive.
The type of action is between 1 and 3, inclusive.
The row indices of the action are between 1 and n, inclusive.
The column indices of the action are between 1 and m, inclusive.
For placing barriers, the top-left and bottom-right corners of the rectangle are within the grid, excluding boundaries.
For placing barriers, the top-left and bottom-right corners of the rectangle are within the grid, excluding boundaries.
For removing barriers, the top-left and bottom-right corners of the rectangle are within the grid, excluding boundaries.
For removing barriers, the top-left and bottom-right corners of the rectangle are within the grid, excluding boundaries.
For removing barriers, the specified group of barriers must exist on the ground before the removal.

postconditions.expression: output is a sequence of 'Yes' or 'No'
postconditions.description: The output contains the feasibility of each of Koyomi's attempts.

invariants.expression: all(r1 <= r2 and c1 <= c2 for r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions if t == 1)
invariants.description: For placing barriers, the top-left corner is not further right or below the bottom-right corner.

invariants.expression: all(r1 <= r2 and c1 <= c2 for r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions if t == 2)
invariants.description: For removing barriers, the top-left corner is not further right or below the bottom-right corner.

invariants.expression: all(r1 != r2 and c1 != c2 for r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions if t == 3)
invariants.description: For walking, the start and end cells are different and not in the same row or column.
